citation.title: Present status and future directions: Surgical extrusion, intentional replantation and tooth autotransplantation
citation.authors: Plotino G, Abella Sans F, Duggal MS, Grande NM, Krastl G, Nagendrababu V, Gambarini G

s_design.evidence_quote: review was to provide the reader a complete overview and background on these procedures

domains.note: absent: no Methods section exists; read Abstract, Background and overview, Clinical techniques and materials currently available, Future directions, Conflict of interest, Author contributions, Ethical statement; no protocol, registration or PROSPERO wording anywhere in the text
absent: no search strategy described in any section; no database name (MEDLINE, PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, Scopus), search date or search terms anywhere in the text

3b-iii line 3: neither (a) a screening account with counts nor (b) inclusion/exclusion criteria is reported; read all sections listed above; no PRISMA flow, no records screened/included counts, no eligibility criteria wording

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: absent: no appraisal step in any section; no quality, bias, appraisal or checklist wording applied by the authors to the studies they cite
absent: no pooling, statistical model or heterogeneity analysis performed; meta-analysis wording appears only when citing other authors' reviews
absent: no funnel plot, Egger test or publication bias wording anywhere in the text

penalties.note: CoI statement present; no commercial funder named

penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.evidence_quote: of choice with 82.8% survival rate at four years
penalties.note: survival claims reported in the text carry follow-up of 4 to 5 years (also 1- and 5-year survival from Chung 2014), meeting the 3-year bar; the text states no short-follow-up limitation for these claims, and the Future directions call for long-term follow-ups is a general research recommendation not tied to a specific claim

fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۵ از ۱۰۰ است و در باند E (سطح زمینه/نظر) برای نوع سؤال THERAPY قرار می‌گیرد.
interpretation_fa: این مقاله یک narrative review بدون بخش Methods است؛ جستجوی منظم، ارزیابی کیفیت مطالعات و meta-analysis ندارد، پس سقف طراحی پایین و ضریب روش در حداقل است. ارزش بالینی آن در گردآوری پروتکل‌های گام‌به‌گام surgical extrusion، intentional replantation و autotransplantation است. ارقام survival آن از منابع اولیه نقل شده‌اند و خود مقاله آن‌ها را ارزیابی نکرده است.
